narrative_purpose: Shows the engine one layer below the seafloor: seawater working down into cracked mantle rock, pale new mineral spreading along the fractures, and gas bubbling back out — the reaction that supplies a vent its own heat and its own fuel.
subject: A cutaway through solid dark green-grey rock beneath a seafloor, split by a network of branching fractures running from the top surface down into the depths. Along the walls of every fracture, pale fibrous mineral has grown inward in soft ropey bands, narrowing the cracks. Small clusters of round gas bubbles are rising up through the fracture network toward the top, escaping from the rock surface into the dark water above in thin strings. Deeper down, the rock takes on a faint warm inner glow along the fracture walls where the reaction is hottest.
scene: A vertical slice of subseafloor rock filling almost the whole frame, with a narrow band of dark open water across the very top where the bubbles emerge.
camera: A straight-on vertical cross-section view, as though a wall of rock had been sliced open, filling the frame edge to edge.
light: A faint warm amber glow from within the deeper fractures, cool pale rim light on the fibrous new mineral, the surrounding rock in deep shadow carrying indigo and teal rather than black. The water at the top is dim teal.
palette: Dark green-grey rock throughout, pale desaturated fibrous veins, warm ember-amber confined to the deep fracture interiors as the scarce accent, cool teal for the bubbles and the water above.
style: Painterly geological cutaway in naturalist-plate manner, hand-painted rock texture, the feel of a hand-drawn field cross-section rather than a technical diagram.
detail_level: High detail on the fibrous vein growth and the fracture walls, mid detail in the surrounding rock mass, softening at the frame edges.
composition: Fracture network branching diagonally from upper left down to lower right, bubble strings rising along the upper left, a broad region of undisturbed dark rock at the lower right kept plain for an overlaid callout.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with warmth used sparingly and only deep in the rock; the pale veins must read as fibrous mineral growth filling the cracks, not as painted lines or as glowing energy.
